g.title: Program counter → Instruction ROM · 4 bit · 0100

g.title: Instruction control → Run enable · 1 bit · 0

g.title: Instruction control → Program counter · 1 bit · 1

g.aria-label: Wire Instruction control IMM to Program counter D

g.title: Instruction control → 4-bit ALU · 4 bit · 0010

g.aria-label: Wire Instruction control OP to 4-bit ALU OP

g.title: Accumulator → 4-bit ALU · 4 bit · 0010

g.aria-label: Wire 4-bit ALU Q to Accumulator D
g.title: 4-bit ALU → Accumulator · 4 bit · 0010

g.aria-label: Wire Instruction control LOAD to Accumulator EN

g.aria-label: Wire System reset Q to Output register RST
g.title: System reset → Output register · 1 bit · 0
System clock · A rising-edge clock. Tick manually or run continuously.
Program counter · Increment on rising CLK. Optional parallel load and reset.
Instruction ROM · Configurable read-only instruction or data memory.
Instruction control · 4-bit CPU instruction decoder: LDI, ADD, OUT, JMP, HALT.
4-bit ALU · OP: 0 = B, 1 = A+B, 2 = A AND B, 3 = A XOR B.
Accumulator · Capture a bus on rising CLK when EN is high.
Output register · Capture a bus on rising CLK when EN is high.
OUTPUT · Observe a live bit or bus. Can be a truth-table output.
System reset · Momentary high while held. Space also presses it.
